query: On the basis of real-time HS-AFM imaging, we find that CorA Mg2+-dependent gating can be best described in three phases: Above the apparent Mg2+-affinity of the intracellular Mg2+-sensor sites (~2 mM Mg2+), the channel adopts a stable 5-fold symmetric state reminiscent of the high-resolution structures (phase 1).
